Stuart ran a great 1500m but his partner in the 'B' race, Matt Chaston, was unlucky. Matt was looking good with 200m to go but got tripped and was out of it - his chance will come again.

Heavy points scorers for us during the year were the usual mob - Mike Small, Joe Minetti and Mike Bazire (but we could have done with Joe and Mike B in the Final relay!) Some good 3000's from John Wright, Matt Chaston and, in a surprise turnout, John Gladwin having a time trial with Dave Clarke.
Stuart Paton front ran the 800m and paced the 1500m to enable Matt Chaston to dip well under 4 minutes. In the guest events, Ken was 2nd in the Discus and Phil Lovell won the Pole Vault.
In the Welsh Championships, Justin Chaston won the Junior title while brother Matt placed 4th in the Senior event, both significantly improving their best times during the season.
